text:
sophie: Quick heads-up — I need to trade my oncall for this Sat night (23:00-07:00) due to a last-minute flight change. Can someone take overnight? I can shadow remotely for 03:00-05:00 to handoff.

sophie: There’s a scheduled model update at ~02:30 (v1.9 -> v1.10). Low-risk, but please watch memory & latency. Runbook link: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/model-update

liam: I can cover 23:00-02:00 and do the initial canary. @maya can you pick up 02:00-07:00? If not I can stay on full shift.

maya: I can do 02:00-07:00. I have a dentist appt in the morning but that’s after shift. Will accept invite if you add to calendar. Please leave prewarm steps.

sophie: Prewarm notes:
- run: `./scripts/prewarm.sh --model redwood-tiny --tokens 1024`
- verify: `curl -s http://localhost:8080/health | jq .`
- tail logs: `tail -n 200 /var/log/infra/serving.log | grep "KV cache warmed"`
If latency >400ms or error rate spikes, escalate to #eng-oncall and ping @oncall-bot. If model behaves badly, rollback to v1.9.

jason: FYI infra maintenance window 02:45-03:15 for kernel patching. That overlaps the update — recommend doing canary at 02:25 and hold full rollout until 03:20 if the maintenance is noisy.

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled job "model-update" at 2026-11-07T02:30Z. Alerting policy: 5m windows, critical if >2% errors.

liam: Will start canary at 02:25 (1 replica, 5% traffic), watch traces + latency dashboard (Console -> Deployments -> redwood-serving). If anything > threshold, `kubectl -n serving rollout undo deployment/redwood-serving` and ping here.

sophie: Quick rollback commands in case: 
```
kubectl -n serving rollout undo deployment/redwood-serving
kubectl -n serving get pods -o wide
kubectl -n serving logs deployment/redwood-serving --tail=200
```
Also if CrashLoopBackOff, try `kubectl -n serving scale deployment/redwood-serving --replicas=2` to buy time.

maya: Added a 02:00-02:15 handoff block on my calendar. I’ll monitor 02:00-03:30 closely because of the maintenance overlap. :thumbsup:

sophie: Thanks all. I’ll DM the handoff token and a short note about my kid situation. @liam @maya please reply here once you’ve accepted the calendar invites so I can close this out.

liam: Invite accepted.

maya: Invite accepted and handbook note updated: https://redwood-internal/handbook/oncall#prewarm-and-updates

sophie: Awesome — appreciate it. Leaving a short post-shift checklist in the handbook and I’ll follow up in #eng-oncall if anything changes. Good luck and thanks again!
